quotes.text: There was no Plan B in my life, ever

I'm a seventeen-year-old kid and suddenly I'm sharing a microphone on stage with the biggest rock star in New Jersey. I've got high school in the morning, and the teacher just sounds like 'Wah wah wah, wah wah wah', because I'm thinking Bruce will probably want me to come over to his house tomorrow, now that we're friends. I had rainbows and unicorns in my head, like an acid trip, because now I had seen the world in colour.
